title: The 1775 Declaration of the Causes of Taking Up Arms states why Congress says it is arming
summary: The 6 July 1775 declaration is Congress's statement of why it is taking up arms.
body: Avalon prints the 6 July 1775 Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms. Congress explains why it is raising forces, a year before the Declaration of Independence. The document is Congress's case. It is not a British minister's reply. The wording on the page includes: "Now Met in Congress at Philadelphia, Setting Forth the Causes and Necessity of Their Taking Up Arms.(1) If it was possible for men, who exercise their reason to believe, that the divine Author of our existence intended a part of the human race to hold an absolute property in, and an unbounded power over others, marked out by his infinite goodness and".
